title: 第5章 只要趴下真能恢复第6章 弟子的关心苏婉卿的欣慰
slug: 师尊修为尽失后宠妻系统来了
content_zh:
第5章只要趴下，真能恢复！一开始，苏婉卿对楚宁并没有多少忌惮之意。
可后来察觉到了，她如今修为已经失去，最应该担心的是自己的清白。
宗门之内，那些长老，个个人面兽心，巅峰之时对你吹捧崇拜，低谷之时对你嘲讽谩骂。
即便是真的做了什么，她也只能以死保全清白！
而苏婉卿也做好了这些准备，她一开始想要轻生，其实大多因此！
受尽凌辱苟活，非她苏婉卿所要，宁可玉碎不为瓦全！
可没想到弟子，真的能帮助她恢复身躯，虽然只有一些进展，但那就是希望！
床榻之上，苏婉卿仍是眼神温柔地望着昏迷的楚宁，轻轻为其盖上被子。
“宁儿，长大了........”
.......
第一次运转长春不灭诀，楚宁也没控制住自己。
因为他看到了进度，想着多做一点。
没想到，直接做虚脱了，昏迷过去了。
只是，当她再度睁开眼睛醒来，映入眼帘的却不是自己的洞府。
精致木床，空气中飘荡着淡淡的撩人的香气，瞬间让楚宁支楞起来！
从床上坐起来了！
不是，这是哪！
打眼一看，这不就是师尊洞府么！
他昨晚昏迷过去，是在苏婉卿房间里睡着的？
伸手一摸，绸被精致而光滑，如同女子的肌肤，如同昨日伸手轻抚在苏婉卿身上，格外撩人。

楚宁倒吸了一口凉气。
这......
他如今，道心果然不宁了！
无奈深吸了一口气，查看系统面板。
楚宁
资质：中品灵根
哦，似乎是帮师尊恢复修为，给了个暴击，然后提升了一下资质。
系统真bug啊！
修为：淬体四层
楚宁看到修为的时候一愣。
应该是运转长春不灭决所带来的提升对吧？
这功法，真的很不简单，甚至可以修炼大成，成就长春道体！
师尊苏婉卿就是天道剑骨，属于先天道体，百年修行便要步入圣人境界了，绝对的天骄。
还从没听过，后天修行能步入道体的？
功法不简单！
贡献点剩余：16000!
楚宁见此一愣，立马脸上露出笑容。
content_en:
Chapter 5: As long as you lie down, you can really recover! At first, Su Wanqing didn't have much fear towards Chu Ning.
But later she realized that she had lost her cultivation, and what she should worry about most was her innocence.
Within the sect, those elders all have beastly faces. They will praise you and worship you when they are at their peak, and ridicule and abuse you when they are at their lowest.
Even if she really did something, she could only die to keep her innocence!
And Su Wanqing was also well prepared. She wanted to commit suicide at first, but that was mostly because of this!
She, Su Wanqing, doesn't want to survive being humiliated and humiliated. She would rather be broken into pieces than destroyed!
But she didn't expect that the disciple could really help her recover her body. Although there was only some progress, that was hope!
On the bed, Su Wanqing still looked at the unconscious Chu Ning with gentle eyes, and gently covered him with a quilt.
"Ning'er, grow up..."
.......
For the first time, Chu Ning couldn't control himself when he used the Changchun Immortal Art.
Because he saw the progress and wanted to do more.
Unexpectedly, I collapsed and passed out.
However, when she opened her eyes again and woke up, what she saw was not her own cave.
The exquisite wooden bed, with its faint and sultry aroma floating in the air, instantly made Chu Ning stunned!
Sitting up from the bed!
No, where is this!
Take a quick look, isn't this the master's cave?
He fell into a coma last night and fell asleep in Su Wanqing's room?
He stretched out his hand and touched it. The silk quilt was delicate and smooth, just like a woman's skin. It was as if he reached out and caressed Su Wanqing's body yesterday, which was particularly sultry.
Chu Ning took a breath of cold air.
This...
Now, his Taoist heart is really restless!
Helplessly, I took a deep breath and checked the system panel.
Chu Ning
Qualification: Middle-grade spiritual root
Oh, it seems that he helped the master recover his cultivation, gave him a critical hit, and then improved his qualifications.
The system is really buggy!
Cultivation: Fourth level of body tempering
Chu Ning was stunned when she saw her cultivation.
It should be the improvement brought about by running the Changchun Immortal Jue, right?
This technique is really not simple, it can even be practiced to a great extent and achieve the Changchun Dao Body!
Master Su Wanqing is the Heavenly Dao Sword Bone, which belongs to the innate Dao body. After a hundred years of practice, he will enter the realm of a saint. He is an absolute genius.
Have you never heard of someone who can enter the Taoist body by cultivating the day after tomorrow?
The technique is not simple!
Contribution points remaining: 16,000!
Chu Ning was stunned when he saw this, and a smile immediately appeared on his face.
